annotations.title: Run a command in a sandbox

description: Run a command in a sandbox. Runs one command in the sandbox with `/bin/sh -lc` and answers its exit code and output. A sandbox that is still starting is waited for (up to a minute). The sandbox's own `env` is set, under the command's. Use `?stream=1` for commands that run longer than about 90 seconds.
name: sandbox_exec
title: Run a command in a sandbox
